#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pairwise AUC decay curves: auto-discovers experiment JSONs and plots all configs.

Input:  results_*/pairwise_auc.json, results/*/pairwise_auc.json, data_*/pairwise_auc.json
Output: artifacts/figures/fig2_auc_decay.pdf
Deps:   matplotlib, numpy
"""

import argparse
import json
import re
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

# ── Color/style rotation ──
TABLEAU_COLORS = [
    "#4e79a7", "#e15759", "#76b7b2", "#59a14f",
    "#b07aa1", "#ff9da7", "#9c755f", "#bab0ac",
    "#edc948", "#f28e2b",
]
MARKERS = ["o", "s", "^", "D", "v", "P", "X", "*", "h", "<"]
LINESTYLES_SOLID = ["-", "-", "-", "-", "-", "-", "-", "-"]
LINESTYLES_DASHED = ["--", "--", "--", "--", "--", "--", "--", "--"]


def infer_label(dir_path: Path) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Infer display label and group (model/decode) from directory name."""
    name = dir_path.name

    decode_patterns = {
        "greedy": "Greedy", "nuc09": "Nuc p=0.9", "nuc0.9": "Nuc p=0.9",
        "t07": "T=0.7", "t0.7": "T=0.7", "t12": "T=1.2", "t1.2": "T=1.2",
    }
    for pat, label in decode_patterns.items():
        if pat in name.lower():
            return label, "decode"

    model_patterns = [
        (r"qwen.*rw|qwen.*rewrite", "Qwen-rewrite"),
        (r"qwen.*base", "Qwen-base"),
        (r"qwen.*7b", "Qwen-7B"),
        (r"qwen.*cont|qwen(?!.*rw|.*rewrite|.*base|.*7b)", "Qwen-cont"),
        (r"pythia", "Pythia-cont"),
        (r"olmo", "OLMo-cont"),
        (r"mistral.*7b", "Mistral-7B"),
        (r"llama.*8b", "LLaMA-8B"),
    ]
    for pat, label in model_patterns:
        if re.search(pat, name, re.IGNORECASE):
            return label, "model"

    clean = name.replace("results_", "").replace("results", "").replace("data_", "")
    clean = re.sub(r"^exp\d+_?", "", clean).strip("_") or name
    return clean, "model"


def discover_auc_files(root: Path) -> list[Path]:
    """Find all pairwise_auc.json under results_*/, results/*/, data_*/."""
    patterns = [
        "results_*/pairwise_auc.json",
        "results/*/pairwise_auc.json",
        "data_*/pairwise_auc.json",
    ]
    files = []
    for pat in patterns:
        files.extend(sorted(root.glob(pat)))
    return files


def load_auc_data(json_path: Path) -> dict[str, float] | None:
    """Load pairwise AUC from JSON. Returns {pair: auc} dict or None."""
    with open(json_path) as f:
        raw = json.load(f)
    if "mean" in raw:
        return raw["mean"]
    pairs = {}
    for key in ["0v1", "1v2", "2v3", "3v4", "4v5"]:
        if key in raw:
            val = raw[key]
            if isinstance(val, dict):
                pairs[key] = val.get("auc", val.get("mean"))
            else:
                pairs[key] = val
    return pairs if pairs else None


def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Plot pairwise AUC decay curves")
    parser.add_argument("--results-dir", type=Path,
                        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent,
                        help="Root directory to scan for results")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=None,
                        help="Output PDF path (default: artifacts/figures/fig2_auc_decay.pdf)")
    parser.add_argument("--filter", type=str, default=None,
                        help="Filter models by substring (case-insensitive)")
    return parser.parse_args()


def main():
    args = parse_args()
    root = args.results_dir

    auc_files = discover_auc_files(root)
    if not auc_files:
        print(f"No pairwise_auc.json found under {root}")
        return

    models = {}  # label -> {group, data}
    for fp in auc_files:
        parent = fp.parent
        label, group = infer_label(parent)
        data = load_auc_data(fp)
        if data is None:
            continue
        if args.filter and args.filter.lower() not in label.lower():
            continue
        models[label] = {"group": group, "data": data}

    if not models:
        print("No valid AUC data found after filtering")
        return

    model_items = [(k, v) for k, v in models.items() if v["group"] == "model"]
    decode_items = [(k, v) for k, v in models.items() if v["group"] == "decode"]

    x_labels = ["0 vs 1", "1 vs 2", "2 vs 3", "3 vs 4", "4 vs 5"]
    pair_keys = ["0v1", "1v2", "2v3", "3v4", "4v5"]
    x = np.arange(len(x_labels))

    # ── Style ──
    plt.rcParams.update({
        "font.family": "serif",
        "font.size": 11,
        "axes.linewidth": 0.8,
        "xtick.major.width": 0.8,
        "ytick.major.width": 0.8,
    })

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4), constrained_layout=True)

    ax.axvspan(0.5, 1.5, color="#fff9c4", alpha=0.55, zorder=0)
    ax.text(1.0, 1.02, r"$K^*$ boundary", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9,
            fontstyle="italic", color="#8d6e00")

    ax.axhline(0.60, color="grey", ls="--", lw=0.8, zorder=1)
    ax.text(4.55, 0.608, r"$\theta = 0.60$", fontsize=8.5, color="grey", va="bottom", ha="right")
    ax.axhline(0.50, color="lightgrey", ls="--", lw=0.8, zorder=1)
    ax.text(4.55, 0.508, "chance", fontsize=8.5, color="silver", va="bottom", ha="right")

    model_handles = []
    for i, (label, info) in enumerate(model_items):
        color = TABLEAU_COLORS[i % len(TABLEAU_COLORS)]
        marker = MARKERS[i % len(MARKERS)]
        y = [info["data"].get(k, np.nan) for k in pair_keys]
        line, = ax.plot(x, y, "-", color=color, lw=1.8, marker=marker,
                        markersize=5, label=label, zorder=3)
        model_handles.append(line)

    decode_handles = []
    for i, (label, info) in enumerate(decode_items):
        color = TABLEAU_COLORS[(len(model_items) + i) % len(TABLEAU_COLORS)]
        marker = MARKERS[(len(model_items) + i) % len(MARKERS)]
        y = [info["data"].get(k, np.nan) for k in pair_keys]
        line, = ax.plot(x, y, "--", color=color, lw=1.8, marker=marker,
                        markersize=5, label=label, zorder=3)
        decode_handles.append(line)

    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(x_labels)
    ax.set_xlabel("Depth Pair")
    ax.set_ylabel("Pairwise AUC (5-fold CV)")
    ax.set_ylim(0.45, 1.05)
    ax.set_xlim(-0.25, len(x_labels) - 0.75)
    ax.tick_params(direction="in")

    if model_handles:
        leg1 = ax.legend(handles=model_handles, title="Models", title_fontsize=9,
                         fontsize=8.5, loc="upper right", bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.98),
                         framealpha=0.9, edgecolor="0.8")
        ax.add_artist(leg1)
    if decode_handles:
        ax.legend(handles=decode_handles, title="Decoding", title_fontsize=9,
                  fontsize=8.5, loc="center right", bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.58),
                  framealpha=0.9, edgecolor="0.8")
    elif model_handles:
        ax.legend(handles=model_handles, title="Models", title_fontsize=9,
                  fontsize=8.5, loc="upper right", bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.98),
                  framealpha=0.9, edgecolor="0.8")

    # ── Save ──
    if args.output:
        out_path = args.output
    else:
        out_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "figures"
        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        out_path = out_dir / "fig2_auc_decay.pdf"

    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fig.savefig(out_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    png_path = out_path.with_suffix(".png")
    fig.savefig(png_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)

    pdf_size = out_path.stat().st_size
    png_size = png_path.stat().st_size
    print(f"Discovered {len(models)} configs: {list(models.keys())}")
    print(f"PDF: {pdf_size/1024:.1f} KB | PNG: {png_size/1024:.1f} KB")
    assert pdf_size > 5 * 1024, f"PDF too small: {pdf_size}"
    print("OK")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Figure 2: AUC decay across depth pairs — optimized for EMNLP column width."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# ── Semantic color palette (Okabe-Ito, project-consistent) ──
COLORS = {
    "baseline":  "#0072B2",
    "treatment": "#E69F00",
    "collapse":  "#D55E00",
    "safe":      "#009E73",
    "neutral":   "#999999",
}

# Model configs: group by K*=2 (strong signal) vs K*=1 (weak)
MODELS_K2 = {
    "Qwen-rw": {
        "auc": [0.9956, 0.6955, 0.5893, 0.5435, 0.5340],
        "ci_lo": [0.993, 0.686, 0.580, 0.534, 0.524],
        "ci_hi": [0.998, 0.704, 0.599, 0.553, 0.544],
    },
    "Pythia-1.4B": {
        "auc": [0.9932, 0.6539, 0.5514, 0.5152, 0.5136],
        "ci_lo": [0.991, 0.645, 0.542, 0.505, 0.504],
        "ci_hi": [0.996, 0.663, 0.563, 0.525, 0.524],
    },
    "Qwen-cont": {
        "auc": [0.9971, 0.6112, 0.5609, 0.5409, 0.5141],
        "ci_lo": [0.996, 0.602, 0.551, 0.531, 0.504],
        "ci_hi": [0.999, 0.621, 0.571, 0.551, 0.524],
    },
    "Qwen-7B": {
        "auc": [0.9638, 0.6168, 0.5492, 0.5276, 0.5085],
        "ci_lo": [0.961, 0.608, 0.539, 0.517, 0.499],
        "ci_hi": [0.967, 0.626, 0.559, 0.538, 0.519],
    },
    "LLaMA-8B": {
        "auc": [0.9225, 0.6123, 0.5274, 0.5138, 0.5097],
        "ci_lo": [0.917, 0.603, 0.517, 0.506, 0.505],
        "ci_hi": [0.927, 0.622, 0.538, 0.528, 0.527],
    },
    "Qwen-base": {
        "auc": [0.9870, 0.6262, 0.5496, 0.5294, 0.5182],
        "ci_lo": [0.985, 0.617, 0.540, 0.519, 0.508],
        "ci_hi": [0.989, 0.635, 0.560, 0.540, 0.529],
    },
}

MODELS_K1 = {
    "OLMo": {
        "auc": [0.9860, 0.5080, 0.4973, 0.5024, 0.4942],
        "ci_lo": [0.983, 0.496, 0.486, 0.492, 0.484],
        "ci_hi": [0.989, 0.519, 0.509, 0.513, 0.505],
    },
    "Mistral-7B": {
        "auc": [0.9843, 0.5935, 0.5402, 0.5232, 0.5181],
        "ci_lo": [0.981, 0.584, 0.530, 0.513, 0.508],
        "ci_hi": [0.988, 0.603, 0.550, 0.533, 0.528],
    },
}

# Visual mapping: K*=2 models get saturated colors, K*=1 get muted
MODEL_STYLES_K2 = {
    "Qwen-rw":    {"color": "#0072B2", "marker": "o"},
    "Pythia-1.4B": {"color": "#D55E00", "marker": "s"},
    "Qwen-cont":  {"color": "#009E73", "marker": "^"},
    "Qwen-7B":    {"color": "#CC79A7", "marker": "D"},
    "LLaMA-8B":   {"color": "#E69F00", "marker": "v"},
    "Qwen-base":  {"color": "#56B4E9", "marker": "P"},
}

MODEL_STYLES_K1 = {
    "OLMo":       {"color": "#BBBBBB", "marker": "x"},
    "Mistral-7B": {"color": "#AAAAAA", "marker": "+"},
}

x_labels = ["0v1", "1v2", "2v3", "3v4", "4v5"]
x = np.arange(len(x_labels))

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
    "font.size": 9,
    "axes.linewidth": 0.6,
    "xtick.major.width": 0.6,
    "ytick.major.width": 0.6,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "pdf.fonttype": 42,
    "ps.fonttype": 42,
    "figure.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.03,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.4, 2.6))

# ── Narrative layers ──
# Discriminable zone (above theta)
ax.axhspan(0.60, 1.05, color="#E8F5E9", alpha=0.35, zorder=0)
ax.axhspan(0.45, 0.60, color="#FFF3E0", alpha=0.25, zorder=0)

# Threshold line
ax.axhline(0.60, color="#666666", ls="--", lw=0.7, zorder=1)
t = ax.text(4.38, 0.605, r"$\theta{=}0.60$", fontsize=6.5, color="#666666",
            va="bottom", ha="right")
t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground="white")])

# Chance line
ax.axhline(0.50, color="#CCCCCC", ls=":", lw=0.5, zorder=1)
t2 = ax.text(4.38, 0.504, "chance", fontsize=6, color="#BBBBBB",
             va="bottom", ha="right")
t2.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground="white")])

# ── Plot K*=2 models (saturated, solid) ──
k2_handles = []
for label, info in MODELS_K2.items():
    sty = MODEL_STYLES_K2[label]
    y = np.array(info["auc"])
    lo = np.array(info["ci_lo"])
    hi = np.array(info["ci_hi"])
    ax.fill_between(x, lo, hi, color=sty["color"], alpha=0.10, zorder=2)
    line, = ax.plot(x, y, "-", color=sty["color"], lw=1.3, marker=sty["marker"],
                    markersize=3.5, markeredgewidth=0.5, markeredgecolor="white",
                    label=label, zorder=3, solid_capstyle="round")
    k2_handles.append(line)

# ── Plot K*=1 models (muted, dashed) ──
k1_handles = []
for label, info in MODELS_K1.items():
    sty = MODEL_STYLES_K1[label]
    y = np.array(info["auc"])
    if "ci_lo" in info:
        lo = np.array(info["ci_lo"])
        hi = np.array(info["ci_hi"])
        ax.fill_between(x, lo, hi, color=sty["color"], alpha=0.08, zorder=2)
    line, = ax.plot(x, y, "--", color=sty["color"], lw=1.0, marker=sty["marker"],
                    markersize=4, markeredgewidth=0.8, label=label, zorder=3)
    k1_handles.append(line)

# ── Axes ──
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(x_labels, fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("Depth Pair", fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("Pairwise AUC", fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0.45, 1.03)
ax.set_xlim(-0.2, len(x_labels) - 0.7)
ax.tick_params(direction="in", labelsize=7.5, length=3)

# ── Legend: two groups ──
from matplotlib.legend import Legend

leg1 = ax.legend(handles=k2_handles, title=r"$K^*{=}2$", title_fontsize=6.5,
                 fontsize=6, loc="upper right", bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.98),
                 framealpha=0.92, edgecolor="#DDDDDD", fancybox=True,
                 handlelength=1.5, borderpad=0.3, labelspacing=0.2,
                 handletextpad=0.4, columnspacing=0.8)
ax.add_artist(leg1)

leg2 = Legend(ax, k1_handles, [h.get_label() for h in k1_handles],
             title=r"$K^*{=}1$", title_fontsize=6.5,
             fontsize=6, loc="center right", bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.38),
             framealpha=0.92, edgecolor="#DDDDDD", fancybox=True,
             handlelength=1.5, borderpad=0.3, labelspacing=0.2,
             handletextpad=0.4)
ax.add_artist(leg2)

# Zone labels
ax.text(0.02, 0.97, "discriminable", transform=ax.transAxes,
        fontsize=5.5, color="#4CAF50", alpha=0.6, va="top", fontstyle="italic")
ax.text(0.02, 0.30, "indistinguishable", transform=ax.transAxes,
        fontsize=5.5, color="#E65100", alpha=0.5, va="top", fontstyle="italic")

plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)

out_dir = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_7/projects/gen-depth-contamination/docs/paper/figures"
fig.savefig(f"{out_dir}/fig2_auc_decay.pdf")
fig.savefig(f"{out_dir}/fig2_auc_decay.png")
plt.close(fig)
print("OK fig2")

"""Figure 2: AUC decay across depth pairs — optimized for EMNLP column width.

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

# ── Data (verified against Table 1 / Table S2b) ──
MODELS = [

                   [0.996, 0.663, 0.563, 0.525, 0.524], 2),
    ("Qwen-cont",  [0.9971, 0.6112, 0.5609, 0.5409, 0.5141],

    ("LLaMA-8B",   [0.9225, 0.6123, 0.5274, 0.5138, 0.5097],
                   [0.917, 0.603, 0.517, 0.506, 0.505],
                   [0.927, 0.622, 0.538, 0.528, 0.527], 2),
    ("Qwen-base",  [0.9870, 0.6262, 0.5496, 0.5294, 0.5182],

                   [0.989, 0.635, 0.560, 0.540, 0.529], 2),
    ("OLMo",       [0.9860, 0.5080, 0.4973, 0.5024, 0.4942],

# Okabe-Ito semantic colors
STYLE = {
    "Qwen-rw":    {"c": "#0072B2", "m": "o"},
    "Pythia-1.4B": {"c": "#D55E00", "m": "s"},
    "Qwen-cont":  {"c": "#009E73", "m": "^"},
    "Qwen-7B":    {"c": "#CC79A7", "m": "D"},
    "LLaMA-8B":   {"c": "#E69F00", "m": "v"},
    "Qwen-base":  {"c": "#56B4E9", "m": "P"},
    "OLMo":       {"c": "#AAAAAA", "m": "x"},
    "Mistral-7B": {"c": "#888888", "m": "+"},
}

x_labels = ["0v1", "1v2", "2v3", "3v4", "4v5"]
x = np.arange(len(x_labels))

plt.rcParams.update({

ax.axhspan(0.60, 1.05, color="#F1F8E9", alpha=0.4, zorder=0, lw=0)
ax.axhspan(0.45, 0.60, color="#FFF8E1", alpha=0.3, zorder=0, lw=0)

ax.axhline(0.50, color="#CCCCCC", ls=":", lw=0.4, zorder=1)

for name, auc, lo, hi, kstar in MODELS:
    s = STYLE[name]
    y = np.array(auc)
    ci_lo, ci_hi = np.array(lo), np.array(hi)

    ls = "-" if kstar == 2 else "--"

    alpha_fill = 0.10 if kstar == 2 else 0.06

                    zorder=3, solid_capstyle="round")
    handles.append((line, name, kstar))

k2_lines = [(h, n) for h, n, k in handles if k == 2]
k1_lines = [(h, n) for h, n, k in handles if k == 1]

# Section headers as invisible proxy artists
header_k2 = Line2D([], [], color="none", label=r"$\mathbf{K^*{=}2}$")
header_k1 = Line2D([], [], color="none", label=r"$\mathbf{K^*{=}1}$")

leg = ax.legend(legend_handles, legend_labels,
                fontsize=5.5, loc="right", bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.62),
                framealpha=0.93, edgecolor="#DDDDDD", fancybox=True,
                handlelength=1.6, borderpad=0.35, labelspacing=0.18,
                handletextpad=0.4, ncol=1)

# Bold the header entries
for text in leg.get_texts():
    if text.get_text().startswith("$"):
        text.set_fontsize(6)

# ── Axes ──
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(x_labels, fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_xlabel("Depth Pair", fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_ylabel("Pairwise AUC", fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_ylim(0.46, 1.02)
ax.set_xlim(-0.15, len(x_labels) - 0.65)
ax.tick_params(direction="in", labelsize=7, length=2.5)

out_dir = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_7/projects/gen-depth-contamination/docs/paper/figures"

fig.savefig(f"{out_dir}/fig2_auc_decay.png")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Figure 3: two-panel K*(theta) figure.

Panel (a): Pairwise AUC profile across depth pairs (C4 configs)
Panel (b): K*(theta) sensitivity

Output: docs/paper/figures/fig_kstar_theta.pdf
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

PAIR_KEYS = ["0v1", "1v2", "2v3", "3v4", "4v5"]

MODELS = {
    "Qwen-rw": {
        "mean":     [0.9956, 0.6955, 0.5893, 0.5435, 0.5340],
        "ci_lower": [0.9946, 0.6859, 0.5795, 0.5333, 0.5238],
        "ci_upper": [0.9976, 0.7041, 0.5991, 0.5551, 0.5448],
    },
    "Pythia": {
        "mean":     [0.9932, 0.6539, 0.5514, 0.5152, 0.5136],
        "ci_lower": [0.9921, 0.6454, 0.5417, 0.5041, 0.5021],
        "ci_upper": [0.9943, 0.6630, 0.5628, 0.5260, 0.5249],
    },
    "OLMo": {
        "mean":     [0.9970, 0.6145, 0.5496, 0.5091, 0.5045],
        "ci_lower": [0.9964, 0.6045, 0.5399, 0.4973, 0.4932],
        "ci_upper": [0.9975, 0.6247, 0.5596, 0.5200, 0.5150],
    },
    "Qwen-cont": {
        "mean":     [0.9971, 0.6112, 0.5609, 0.5409, 0.5141],
        "ci_lower": [0.9963, 0.6015, 0.5511, 0.5308, 0.5035],
        "ci_upper": [0.9978, 0.6213, 0.5712, 0.5508, 0.5255],
    },
    "Qwen-7B": {
        "mean":     [0.9638, 0.6168, 0.5492, 0.5276, 0.5085],
        "ci_lower": [0.9610, 0.6080, 0.5390, 0.5180, 0.4990],
        "ci_upper": [0.9670, 0.6260, 0.5590, 0.5370, 0.5180],
    },
}

TABLEAU = [
    "#4e79a7", "#e15759", "#76b7b2", "#59a14f", "#b07aa1",
    "#ff9da7", "#9c755f", "#bab0ac", "#edc948", "#f28e2b",
]
MARKERS = ["o", "s", "^", "D", "v", "P", "X", "*", "h", "<"]


def compute_kstar(ci_lowers, theta):
    k = 0
    for v in ci_lowers:
        if v >= theta:
            k += 1
        else:
            break
    return k


def main():
    x = np.arange(len(PAIR_KEYS))
    thetas = np.arange(0.50, 0.751, 0.005)

    plt.rcParams.update({
        "font.family": "serif",
        "font.size": 10,
        "axes.linewidth": 0.8,
        "xtick.direction": "in",
        "ytick.direction": "in",
        "xtick.major.width": 0.8,
        "ytick.major.width": 0.8,
    })

    fig, (ax_a, ax_b) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 3.5),
                                      gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [1, 1.15]})

    # ── Panel (a): Pairwise AUC profile ─────────────────────────────────
    ax_a.axhline(0.60, color="grey", ls="--", lw=0.8, zorder=1)
    ax_a.text(4.05, 0.607, r"$\theta = 0.60$", fontsize=8, color="grey",
              va="bottom", ha="right")

    ax_a.axvspan(1.5, 2.5, color="#4e79a7", alpha=0.06, zorder=0)
    ax_a.annotate(r"$K^*\!=\!2$", xy=(1.7, 0.68), fontsize=8, color="#4e79a7",
                  alpha=0.7)

    for i, (name, data) in enumerate(MODELS.items()):
        color = TABLEAU[i % len(TABLEAU)]
        marker = MARKERS[i % len(MARKERS)]
        means = data["mean"]
        lo = data["ci_lower"]
        hi = data["ci_upper"]

        ax_a.fill_between(x, lo, hi, color=color, alpha=0.15, linewidth=0)
        ax_a.plot(x, means, "-", color=color, lw=1.6, marker=marker,
                  markersize=4.5, label=name, zorder=3)

    ax_a.set_xticks(x)
    ax_a.set_xticklabels(PAIR_KEYS)
    ax_a.set_xlabel("Depth pair")
    ax_a.set_ylabel("Pairwise AUC")
    ax_a.set_ylim(0.47, 1.02)
    ax_a.set_xlim(-0.25, len(PAIR_KEYS) - 0.75)
    ax_a.legend(fontsize=7.5, loc="upper right", framealpha=0.92,
                edgecolor="0.85", handlelength=2.0)
    ax_a.set_title(r"$\bf{(a)}$" + " Pairwise AUC profile", fontsize=10,
                   loc="left", pad=6)

    # ── Panel (b): K*(θ) sensitivity ────────────────────────────────────
    all_kstar = {}
    for name, data in MODELS.items():
        ci_lo = data["ci_lower"]
        ks = [compute_kstar(ci_lo, t) for t in thetas]
        all_kstar[name] = ks

    kstar_arr = np.array(list(all_kstar.values()))
    k_min = kstar_arr.min(axis=0)
    k_max = kstar_arr.max(axis=0)

    mask_23 = (k_min >= 2) & (k_max <= 3) & (k_min != k_max)
    mask_2  = (k_min == 2) & (k_max == 2)

    for j in range(len(thetas)):
        if mask_23[j]:
            ax_b.axvspan(thetas[j] - 0.0025, thetas[j] + 0.0025,
                         color="#cccccc", alpha=0.5, linewidth=0, zorder=0)
        if mask_2[j]:
            ax_b.axvspan(thetas[j] - 0.0025, thetas[j] + 0.0025,
                         color="#b8d4e3", alpha=0.5, linewidth=0, zorder=0)

    for i, (name, ks) in enumerate(all_kstar.items()):
        color = TABLEAU[i % len(TABLEAU)]
        ax_b.step(thetas, ks, where="post", label=name,
                  linewidth=1.6, color=color)

    ax_b.axvline(x=0.60, color="grey", ls="--", lw=0.8, alpha=0.7)
    ax_b.text(0.605, 5.15, r"$\theta=0.60$", color="grey", fontsize=8,
              va="top")

    import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
    legend_patches = [
        mpatches.Patch(color="#cccccc", alpha=0.5, label=r"$K^*\!\in\!\{2,3\}$ (all models)"),
        mpatches.Patch(color="#b8d4e3", alpha=0.5, label=r"$K^*\!=\!2$ (all models)"),
    ]
    handles_lines = []
    for i, name in enumerate(all_kstar.keys()):
        color = TABLEAU[i % len(TABLEAU)]
        h = plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=color, lw=1.6, label=name)
        handles_lines.append(h)

    ax_b.legend(handles=legend_patches + handles_lines, fontsize=7.5,
                loc="upper right", framealpha=0.92, edgecolor="0.85")

    ax_b.set_xlabel(r"Threshold $\theta$")
    ax_b.set_ylabel(r"$K^*(\theta)$")
    ax_b.set_xlim(0.495, 0.755)
    max_k = max(len(v) for v in MODELS.values())
    ax_b.set_ylim(-0.2, max_k + 0.5)
    ax_b.set_yticks(range(max_k + 1))
    ax_b.grid(axis="y", color="#e0e0e0", linewidth=0.5)
    ax_b.set_title(r"$\bf{(b)}$" + r" $K^*(\theta)$ sensitivity", fontsize=10,
                   loc="left", pad=6)

    fig.tight_layout()

    out_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "docs" / "paper" / "figures"
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = out_dir / "fig_kstar_theta.pdf"

    fig.savefig(out_path, bbox_inches="tight")
    fig.savefig(out_path.with_suffix(".png"), bbox_inches="tight", dpi=300)
    plt.close(fig)

    print(f"Models: {list(MODELS.keys())}")
    print(f"Saved: {out_path}")
    pdf_size = out_path.stat().st_size
    assert pdf_size > 3 * 1024, f"PDF too small: {pdf_size}"
    print("OK")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
